mapper.sql: SELECT pos.pos_id AS job_id, pos.pos_title AS job_title, pos.pos_company_id AS company_id, cmp.cmp_name AS company_name, cmp.cmp_logo_url AS company_logo_url, cmp.cmp_industry AS company_industry, cmp.cmp_size AS company_size, cmp.cmp_city AS company_city, cmp.cmp_address AS company_address, cmp.cmp_intro AS company_intro, cmp.cmp_detail_json AS company_details, pos.pos_work_city AS work_city, pos.pos_salary_min AS salary_min, pos.pos_salary_max AS salary_max, pos.pos_experience_required AS experience_required, pos.pos_education_required AS education_required, pos.pos_job_type AS job_type, pos.pos_jd_json AS jd_json, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(psk.psk_name ORDER BY psk.psk_required DESC, psk.psk_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_pos_skill psk WHERE psk.psk_position_id = pos.pos_id ) AS skill_names, pos.pos_status AS status_code, pos.pos_created_at AS published_at, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_position_id = pos.pos_id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS applied_flag, ( SELECT app.app_id FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_position_id = pos.pos_id ORDER BY app.app_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS application_id, ( SELECT tal.tal_matched_score FROM t_tal tal WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND tal.tal_company_id = pos.pos_company_id ORDER BY tal.tal_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS match_score FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id
mapper.select:
WHERE pos.pos_status = 1 AND cmp.cmp_status = 1
AND ( pos.pos_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR cmp.cmp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pos.pos_work_city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_pos_skill search_skill WHERE search_skill.psk_position_id = pos.pos_id AND search_skill.psk_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ) )
AND pos.pos_work_city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.city}, '%')
AND pos.pos_work_city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.district}, '%')
AND ( (#{query.employmentType} = 'FULL_TIME' AND pos.pos_job_type = 1) OR (#{query.employmentType} = 'PART_TIME' AND pos.pos_job_type = 2) OR (#{query.employmentType} = 'INTERNSHIP' AND pos.pos_job_type = 3) )
AND pos.pos_education_required >= #{query.education}
ORDER BY pos.pos_salary_max DESC, pos.pos_created_at DESC ORDER BY COALESCE(match_score, 0) DESC, pos.pos_created_at DESC ORDER BY pos.pos_created_at DESC, pos.pos_id DESC
